## Findings / decisions

- **Provenance defect found:** `_provenance_ttl` stamped every synthetic
  per-source capture with the export `generated_at` — a fabrication
  (retrieval times equal retrieval times — F5 09b). Fix: emit the real
  bound captures from `claim_binding_detail` (dedup by `capture_id`) with
  the recorded `retrieved_at`, `content_digest`, the real `ingest_run`
  (joined for connector name/version + started/finished), and the
  S-6-gated upstream reference (`statements.upstream_block`, same lane
  map the statements path uses — hoisted so one derivation feeds both).
  Export run `prov:used` each capture. `provo.Capture` gains
  `content_digest`/`upstream_*` fields; `IngestRun.connector_name`
  becomes optional (edge only when known) + `connector_version`.
- **Extended scope (ED-38 verbatim):** `api/dereference.py` `sig.example/id/`
  → `https://surveillancegraph.org/id/`; `watch.ts` UID → `@surveillancegraph.org`
  (closes D-P35.3-1; `watch-feed-uid` compartment deleted).
- **Out of scope (recorded):** `tasks/.../organised_editing.toml`'s
  `github.com/sig-project/eleutheria` URL is a repo-path literal, not the
  `sig-project.org` domain — not this ticket's class. The `sig.example`
  watch/sentinel surfaces outside the UID (help text, detector names)
  stay — the sentinel *detects* the class.
- **Already-applied `db/{deploy,verify}/vocab_*` + `sqitch.plan` literals:**
  sqitch artifacts are immutable (never edited in place); the vocab
  rows they seeded keep the old IRIs (published-immutability rule), the alias
  map covers the family, and `D-P35.38b-1` files the DB-side re-mint leg.
- **Guard scope:** `git grep` over tracked files minus an explicit allowlist
  (already-applied db artifacts, landed ADR/tickets/build records/risk register,
  the map+note+CHANGELOG themselves, `tests/**`, `ops/sentinels.toml`).
- **Baseline:** clean tree at `cec9402a`; focused suites green pre-change.

## Phase 2 — implementation (appended 2026-10-20T07:3xZ)

**Base switch (R1/R7/R9/R10).** One declared constant per surface, all under
the owned domain: `generate.py BASE → https://ontology.surveillancegraph.org/`
(TECH/CAP/PRED schemes + XWALK_NS + SCHEMA_NS derive), the four schema
`id:`/`sig:` sites + `ontology/vocab/predicates.yaml` `skos_concept_iri` ×286,
`provo.SIG → https://surveillancegraph.org/prov/`,
`formats.SIG_NS → https://surveillancegraph.org/ns/` (@context {sig,@vocab}),
`dereference.SIG → https://surveillancegraph.org/id/` (ED-38),
`ocfl.DEFAULT_USER_ADDRESS → https://surveillancegraph.org`,
`build_predicates.BASE` (docs/build/tools — the registry builder),
`watch.ts WATCH_UID_DOMAIN = "surveillancegraph.org"` (D-P35.3-1's trigger
verbatim; the `watch-feed-uid` sentinel compartment is deleted in the same
change). `ops/sentinels.toml` keeps `sig-project-domain` as the detector it
is — the note now records B-6/ADR-217. `make gen` regenerated
`ontology/generated` (~400 files) + `pylock.toml`.

**Provenance truth (R6).** `_provenance_ttl` rewritten: the SQL gains a
`LEFT JOIN ingest_run` leg (`ir.connector_name/connector_version/
started_at/finished_at` — `BINDING_DETAIL_COLUMNS` mirrors the SELECT);
bound captures dedupe by `capture_id` and carry the recorded
`retrieved_at`, `content_digest` and the S-6-gated upstream reference via
`statements.upstream_block` — one `_claim_lane_map` derivation hoisted to
feed both the statements path and the provenance leg (never two
derivations). Each capture `prov:wasGeneratedBy` its real run and
`prov:wasAttributedTo` its source; the export run `prov:used` every bound
capture. `provo.Capture`/`IngestRun`/`Connector` carry the new optional
fields; absent `claim_binding_detail` degrades to the source-agent +
export-run skeleton — honest absence, never a fabricated capture.

**Compat mechanism (R3/R4/R5).** `docs/governance/iri-base-alias-map.json`
(`sig.iri-alias-map/1`, append-only, 12 families: ontology-schema, the six
vocab schemes, prov-lineage, jsonld-context, api-id-namespace,
ocfl-user-address, watch-feed-uid, crawler-contact-url — `match:
prefix|exact|suffix`), `docs/governance/iri-base-compat-note.md` (linked
from `docs/governance/README.md`), `ADR-217` (cites ADR-168 + the E2
chain, `## Revisit trigger`, trigger-register row +
`docs/build/reports/adr_triggers` check green), the SIG-ENG-039 Appendix F
row in `spec_src/99a_appF_adr.md` (spec rebuilt via BUILD.sh).

**Guard (R1/R7).** `tests/unit/test_identity_base.py` — two legs: (a) no
`sig-project.org`/`sig.example` literal outside declared
history/exempt regions (already-applied db artifacts, landed ADRs/tickets/build
memory, research corpus, risk register, tests, `ops/sentinels.toml`, the
map+note themselves, the two D-P35.38b-2 files); (b) each minted
prefix's scanned hit set equals its declared emitter file set — a second
hard-coded base or a drifted emitter fails. Plus the map/note/ADR-217
integrity checks. 9 tests.

**Deferrals.** `D-P35.3-1` → DONE (obligation-event `D-P35.3-1:e1`
transition + cell flip verbatim). New rows `D-P35.38b-1` (already-applied
`vocab_*` seed IRIs + `sqitch.plan` author lines — the re-stamp is
a DB-side call) and `D-P35.38b-2` (organised-editing disclosure repoint —

**Tests updated:** `test_api_dereference.py`, `test_p363_ate_concept.py`,
